event.decision_instant: the first price row strictly after a funding print at or beyond the SEARCH cut point
event.entry_rule: q {5,10} percent x side {fade,follow} x hold {8,24} h = 8 cells; cut points per ticker from SEARCH prints only; far touch; one position per ticker

prediction: at least one cell has PF >= 1.3 at taker with the 0.02 percent haircut and PF >= 1.0 at the 0.05 percent haircut on VALIDATE, n >= 100, a pooled rate >= 3 a day and a BH pass; prior low
kill: a cell is dropped when its pooled rate over the first 7 trade days is under 3.0 a day or its first read has PF under 1.0 at the primary haircut (kill_fast); the 5 percent cells print as 'below rate gate' unless the measured print counts give 3 a day pooled

outputs.survivor_line: market, rule, PF at taker 0.02 and 0.05 percent, n, days, rate a day, margin return and liquidation share at 10, 25 and 50 percent of the maximum leverage
outputs.header: BTC is the only name with prices before 2026-10-21; trades are read in VALIDATE only; the other names trade from 2026-10-21 only

look_ahead.decision_instant: the funding print's time; the signal row is the first price row at or after it
look_ahead.inputs: FUNDX2: the print itself and FIXED per-ticker cut points computed once from SEARCH funding prints only (2026-06-03 to before 2026-09-15, nearest rank, at least 120 prints); nothing from VALIDATE or forward sets them
look_ahead.entry_quote: the NEXT price row after the signal row, far touch (a quote at the print instant is never used); one position per ticker
look_ahead.exit_price: the near touch of the first row at least H hours after entry (tolerance 30 minutes, else skipped); funding paid or received on every print after the entry up to the exit is booked from the labelled rates (positive = longs pay)
